title: Starsea Creatures
text: Star Jellyfish have 6 health and retaliate by pursuing their attacker, charging and bursting for 8 true damage within 5 blocks without harming themselves. Void Mantas have 40 health and retaliate in melee for 10 true damage. Neither proactively attacks players.

Both fly and swim. They prefer reachable waterlike pools within 16 blocks with at least a continuous 3x3x2 volume, and avoid Decayed Timeflow. Without suitable water, they wander roughly 2 to 6 blocks above the ground. Jellyfish swim vertically and horizontally; mantas remain level.

Holding a Spatial Crystal in either hand attracts nearby mantas without interrupting riding, staying or retaliation. Each crystal has a one-in-three chance to tame a manta. Its owner can ride without a saddle; sneak-use toggles following or staying. Riding grants water breathing and starflow protection. Look up or down while moving to change altitude, jump to rise, and sneak to dismount.

Both are space creatures, protected against spatial biome hazards and starflow, but not against time hazards. They evade physical attacks, including melee attacks and arrows, but cannot evade spell projectiles.
A Star Jellyfish drops one Star Jellyfish item on death. A Void Manta drops one Unstable Spacetime Aggregate.

Star Jellyfish can be eaten, restoring 4 hunger and attempting a random teleport like chorus fruit. One also reacts into one Unstable Spacetime Aggregate in either reaction vessel without liquid or a catalyst, taking 100 seconds.
